raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fixes #48127

## Motivation

`RadixArk/Muse-Glimmer-NVFP4` does not start with default flags. Loading fails on its MXFP8 `lm_head` (any GPU), and on Hopper the MXFP8 dense layers then fail in DeepGEMM warmup.

## Modifications

- `fp8.py`: read the attribute as `getattr(layer, "deepgemm_mxfp8_input", False)`, the same form `model_runner.py` uses.
- `modelopt_quant.py`: in `MIXED_PRECISION`, on CUDA when not on Blackwell, MXFP8 linear layers (dense and `lm_head`) get a copy of the MXFP8 config with `convert_mxfp8_to_block_fp8 = True`, so they are converted to block-FP8 [128, 128] at load and use the block-FP8 kernels, as `minimax_m3_nvfp4.py` already does. MoE layers keep the original MXFP8 config. Blackwell and ROCm are unchanged.
- `fp8.py`: the Marlin path takes the block size from the linear method (`self.weight_block_size`, [128, 128] after conversion) instead of the checkpoint config ([1, 32]). Without conversion the two are the same. This matters where Marlin is used for FP8 (auto on SM80 to SM88, or `SGLANG_FORCE_FP8_MARLIN=1`).
- The existing `SGLANG_FORCE_MXFP8_BLOCK_CONVERT` is opt-in and also converts MoE layers, so it does not give a working default.
- Tests (CPU): `test_fp8_lm_head_mxfp8.py` runs the real `process_weights_after_loading` on a real `ParallelLMHead` (block-quant weight processing mocked) and checks the Marlin block size after conversion; `test_modelopt_loader.py` checks through `from_config` and `get_quant_method` that an MXFP8 `down_proj` converts off Blackwell, not on Blackwell, and that the MoE config is untouched. On main, 3 new tests fail: two with the `AttributeError` and one on the missing conversion; with only the `getattr` change, the Marlin test fails on `[1, 32] != [128, 128]`. With this PR both files pass (36 tests).

## Accuracy Tests

1x H200, default `launch_server`, SGLang `c10e0e17735f` with these two files applied:

| Code | Result | `few_shot_gsm8k`, 200 questions, 5-shot |
|---|---|---|
| before | load fails, `AttributeError` | n/a |
| this PR | serves | 0.955 |

Converting 1x32 MXFP8 scales to 128x128 blocks re-quantizes those weights, and there is no BF16 or Blackwell reference here, so the score is a sanity check, not an accuracy comparison. Not run: Blackwell, ROCm, TP > 1, a Marlin GPU (covered by the CPU test only), and MXFP8 MoE checkpoints (code unchanged for them).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not measured. Before this change the model did not start on Hopper.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+"""An MXFP8 lm_head goes through Fp8LinearMethod.process_weights_after_loading.
+
+ParallelLMHead is a VocabParallelEmbedding, not a LinearBase, so it has no
+``deepgemm_mxfp8_input`` attribute. Block-quant weight processing is mocked so
+the test runs on CPU; the rest of process_weights_after_loading is real.
+"""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8Config, Fp8LinearMethod
+from sglang.srt.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import ParallelLMHead
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+
+class TestFp8LmHeadMxfp8(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_process_weights_after_loading_on_mxfp8_lm_head(self):
+        lm_head = ParallelLMHead(256, 128, enable_tp=False)
+        method = Fp8LinearMethod(
+            Fp8Config(is_checkpoint_fp8_serialized=True, use_mxfp8=True)
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(method.block_quant)
+        with patch.object(
+            Fp8LinearMethod, "process_weights_after_loading_block_quant"
+        ) as block_quant:
+            method.process_weights_after_loading(lm_head)
+        block_quant.assert_called_once_with(lm_head)
+        self.assertFalse(getattr(lm_head, "deepgemm_mxfp8_input", False))
+
+    def test_marlin_uses_the_converted_block_size(self):
+        layer = ParallelLMHead(256, 128, enable_tp=False)
+        config = Fp8Config(
+            is_checkpoint_fp8_serialized=True,
+            weight_block_size=[1, 32],
+            use_mxfp8=True,
+        )
+        config.convert_mxfp8_to_block_fp8 = True
+        method = Fp8LinearMethod(config)
+        method.use_marlin = True
+
+        def convert(layer):
+            # The state process_weights_after_loading_block_quant leaves after
+            # converting MXFP8 to block-FP8.
+            method.use_mxfp8 = False
+            method.convert_mxfp8_to_block = False
+            method.weight_block_size = [128, 128]
+
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                Fp8LinearMethod,
+                "process_weights_after_loading_block_quant",
+                side_effect=convert,
+            ),
+            patch("sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8.prepare_fp8_layer_for_marlin"),
+        ):
+            layer.input_scale = None
+            method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+        self.assertEqual(layer.weight_block_size, [128, 128])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main(verbosity=3)
